runs.sql: SELECT DimSalesTerritory.SalesTerritoryCountry, ROUND(SUM(FactResellerSales.SalesAmount), 2) AS reseller_sales FROM FactResellerSales JOIN DimSalesTerritory ON FactResellerSales.SalesTerritoryKey = DimSalesTerritory.SalesTerritoryKey WHERE DimSalesTerritory.SalesTerritoryGroup = 'North America' AND FactResellerSales.OrderDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' GROUP BY DimSalesTerritory.SalesTerritoryCountry
